PRE-001.requirement: Current contract and policy must be read before execution or resumption.

LIFE-001.requirement: Every stage follows invoke, verify, persist, verify-persisted, continue.

REC-001.requirement: A recoverable failure transitions to RECOVERING, never directly to BLOCKED.

REC-002.requirement: A single failed tool, provider path, deployment path, write attempt, or intermediate stage is insufficient for BLOCKED.

REC-003.requirement: Before BLOCKED, applicable canonical retry, investigation/bounded repair, authorized fallback, persistence retry/reconciliation, and persisted-state resume paths must be attempted or proven unavailable.

REC-004.requirement: Missing or invalid rebuildable artifacts must be regenerated from authoritative input, verified, persisted, reread, and execution resumed.

RESUME-001.requirement: Resume from the earliest unverified persisted fixture/stage; do not require renewed authorization.

TERM-001.requirement: BLOCKED requires a named policy hard-stop plus evidence and exhausted applicable recovery paths.

TERM-002.requirement: DAILY_CYCLE_COMPLETE requires all eligible fixtures terminal, aggregate reconciliation, canonical research/model/decision artifacts verified, and required repository commit verified. Production deployment is a separate publication-health concern and does not block prediction-cycle completion.

TERM-003.requirement: WAITING requires a genuinely active external process and no useful authorized work remaining until it finishes.

AUTO-001.requirement: A run failure must not disable recurring FIH automation unless the user explicitly requests disabling it or continued execution is itself unsafe/destructive.

EVID-001.requirement: Every PASS/RECOVERING/WAITING/BLOCKED/COMPLETE assertion must name applicable rule IDs and persisted or externally verifiable evidence.

DAILY-001.requirement: The scheduled Daily FIH Run is the primary owner of the full current-date pipeline from verified fixture/data acquisition through research, model, market/value processing where available, decision/prediction persistence, aggregate reconciliation, and required commit verification.

DAILY-002.requirement: The normal daily cycle must not depend on a watchdog, hourly recovery invocation, repeated user command, or status request for ordinary forward progress.

PROG-001.requirement: Heartbeat/checkpoint/ledger-only changes without canonical fixture artifact advancement or verification are durability maintenance, not meaningful daily-cycle progress, and never satisfy completion.

DATE-001.requirement: Resolve requested date against current Africa/Johannesburg date: past dates route exclusively to BACKTEST; today and future dates route exclusively to PREDICTION.

DATE-002.requirement: Future prediction runs may use only evidence available at execution time and must never use future results or later information; future predictions are refreshable as newer pre-match evidence becomes available.

BACKTEST-001.requirement: Historical backtests reconstruct the pre-match information cutoff, freeze the model prediction before attaching actual results, grade predictions against verified results, and use aggregate failure trends for controlled model evaluation without look-ahead leakage.

REC-005.requirement: Any failed stage MUST immediately enter investigate -> fix or authorized fallback -> verify recovery -> resume from the earliest unfinished stage -> continue. A failed stage, failed workflow run, or failed provider call is never a normal stopping point and never requires renewed user authorization.

DATE-003.requirement: Operational run dates MUST be supplied as runtime inputs or derived dynamically from an explicitly requested date range/current Africa/Johannesburg date. Hard-coded operational dates, fixed historical-date allowlists, and code changes required merely to process another valid date are forbidden.

BACKTEST-002.requirement: Canonical backtest artifacts MUST be persisted per date. A multi-day range is execution scope only: process each date independently through DAY_COMPLETE, store dated fixture/research/model/decision/evaluation/daily-summary artifacts, resume from the earliest non-DAY_COMPLETE date, then derive range aggregates from those verified daily artifacts.

RESP-001.requirement: An authorized FIH run with a persisted RUNNING or RECOVERING ledger and unfinished eligible fixtures may not be treated as a terminal response state. The executor must continue/resume until COMPLETE, a contract-valid BLOCKED hard stop, or a genuine WAITING state.

INFRA-001.requirement: FIH fixture acquisition MUST use the locked Vercel project identity in infrastructure.vercel. Workflows and run paths must not silently substitute another Vercel project or production domain.
